patch_description:
The current program has 6 two-qubit Ising gates but lacks full connectivity. Gen 54 achieved the best score (0.59) with 6 strategically placed Ising gates achieving better worst-group margin (0.31). 

Adding a 7th Ising gate on an uncovered pair [0,7] (connecting opposite ends of the qubit chain) will:
1. Improve the entanglement structure by bridging previously disconnected regions
2. Better separate hardest samples (worst_group_margin metric)
3. Reduce convergence steps (Gen 54: 90 vs Current: 480)

The added gate uses a new unique parameter "xx_07" following the Ising gate naming convention. This increases n_distinct_params from 11 to 12, but the improvement in worst_group_margin should outweigh the small parameter cost, as evidenced by Gen 0's superior robustness despite having 12 parameters.
